description: In-line method invocation - the ISO 8.4.3.1.2 Format 4 identifier, `{object-class-name-1 | identifier-1} :: literal-1 [ ( arguments ) ]` (8.4.3.4.2), reachable from every operand position that admits a function-identifier (the Format-1 twin: 8.4.3.2.3 SR1 and 8.4.3.4.3 SR1 exclude both from a RECEIVING operand in the same words, so no receiving rule admits either - InlineMethodInvocationOperandDriftTests pins that invariant over the .g4 text). Gated at 2002 with the rest of the OO CORE. THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): §2002:8.4.2.4 defines it ('Inline method invocation references a temporary data item returned from invocation of a method'), its operand 'shall be of class object' (§2002:8.4.2.4.2 SR2) and §2002:8.4.2.4.3 GR1 makes it the equivalent INVOKE statement; COBOL-85 has neither the construct nor its operand: its identifier has two formats, function-identifier-1 and data-name-1 with qualifiers, subscripts and a reference-modifier (§1985:IV.4.3.8.5.1 p1: 'An identifier is a syntactically correct sequence of character-strings and separators used to reference data uniquely'), and its data 'are grouped into three classes: alphabetic, numeric, and alphanumeric' (§1985:IV.4.3.3 p1) - no class object; §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 82: 'Object orientation. Support for object oriented programming has been added.' §2014:8.4.2.4 carries the 2002 definition, so 2014 = 2023 (§2023:8.4.3.4.1). Below 2002 the VersionConformancePass parse arm names the edition on RECOGNITION (VisitInlineMethodInvocation -> 0900), which the superseded inline-method-invocation-2023 row could not do: that row described `id(args)` - a shape ISO defines nowhere, carrying no distinctive token - while the real construct is led by the 8.7.4 invocation operator '::' (kb/Work PB428).

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. IMI.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS IMIC.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 OBJ USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE IMIC.
01 W PIC X(2).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    INVOKE IMIC "NEW" RETURNING OBJ.
    MOVE OBJ :: "GETIT" TO W.
    STOP RUN.
END PROGRAM IMI.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
CLASS-ID. IMIC INHERITS FROM BASE.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
REPOSITORY.
    CLASS BASE.
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
OBJECT.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
METHOD-ID. GETIT.
DATA DIVISION.
LINKAGE SECTION.
01 LK PIC X(2).
PROCEDURE DIVISION RETURNING LK.
MAIN.
    MOVE "OK" TO LK.
END METHOD GETIT.
END OBJECT.
END CLASS IMIC.
